caseName: Mitrano v. District of Columbia Bar
caseNameFull: Peter Paul Mitrano v. District of Columbia Bar

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until July 6, 2010, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
